授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項:
共同資源工学専攻（北海道大学）科目。
Held by Hokkaido University.
Geochemical modelling is a useful methodology for reproducing and predicting natural hydrogeochemical and technically induced processes in various environments. It may help to solve diverse problems such as nuclear waste disposal, acid mine drainage, landfill leachate, and deep well injection. This course is intended to provide fundamental knowledge and skills on geochemical modelling to solve various environmental issues and also to predict properties and performance of minerals and materials in the environments.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）:
To understand geochemical processes occurring in various environments.
To learn methods to simulate geochemical processes using computer models.
To perform virtual experiments on their research topics.
To apply geochemical models for environmental practice and research.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Geochemistry, thermodynamics, minerals equilibrium, kinetics, surface complexation, transport, modelling
